VERDICT: REPAIR
I completed independent pass 1 of candidate 80329d0a79a1e71a08af2422ec4d7e8ddfa93ce5, confirmed HEAD matches, and reviewed the full base-to-candidate diff, both touched files, and all candidate tests without editing files or consulting withheld material.
Per-criterion verdicts: AC-3 satisfied for implementation and stated examples (src/math.mjs:68-78; test/math.test.mjs:85-94); R-1 satisfied for implementation (src/math.mjs:69-71) with incomplete candidate coverage; R-2 satisfied (only local extrema updated at src/math.mjs:72-78, input preservation asserted at test/math.test.mjs:96-99); R-3 satisfied (full diff preserves existing functions and existing tests except permitted import at test/math.test.mjs:3); R-4 satisfied (full diff touches only src/math.mjs and test/math.test.mjs, adds no dependencies or generated files); R-5 satisfied (test/math.test.mjs:85,88,91,96 all use range prefix); finding MEDIUM at test/math.test.mjs:91-94: the validation test exercises empty input, a non-array string, and NaN but never a non-number array element or either infinity, leaving required R-1 rejection behavior without regression coverage despite correct current implementation; smallest verification step: add range-prefixed TypeError assertions for [1, "2"], [1, Infinity], and [1, -Infinity], then rerun the isolated range tests.
Checks run: git rev-parse HEAD returned the candidate above; node --test --test-name-pattern="^range" test/ exited 0 with "tests 4", "pass 4", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 19", "pass 18", "fail 1", and only "clamp respects upper bound" failing with "15 !== 10", as explicitly expected and unchanged; supplemental node -e assertions exited 0 with "Supplemental read-only assertions: 10 invalid inputs reject with TypeError; frozen mixed-sign array returns 14" after an initial heredoc invocation was blocked by the read-only sandbox before execution; remaining work is candidate test coverage repair, with no observed range implementation defect and no required check unavailable.
